svg.title: Money first, contract later
svg.desc: A plot on a bench. A dotted footprint with four corner pegs and an address stake marks where the account will stand: the address is reserved before anything is built. Money already arrives there from the wallet that pays the bills today, two ways: coins rolling down a chute, and a pipe with a tap the wallet opens. A stack of coins already sits inside the footprint. A crane behind it is lowering the strongbox, lid and lock, onto the pegs: the agent's first check builds the account around the money.
